text_block_list.text:
In the end, on that day,
I wasn't able to stop Sirius Symboli's words.

However, whether by luck or not, approval for the
'Overseas Expedition Program' had stalled within the committee,
so it hasn't fully gotten underway yet.
choice_data_list: (I have to stop this before it starts.)

text_block_list.text: Whenever I managed to win a match against Sirius Symboli, it was always in billiards.

The difference in ability is clear.
Up until now, most matches were fought with a handicap.
choice_data_list: (Still, let's win this time without any handicaps.)

text_block_list.text:
If I hadn't done at least that much,
I didn't feel like I could stop it.

And so, after work, my days of heading
straight to the pool hall continued—

text_block_list.name: Billiards Coach
text_block_list.text:
So your level is intermediate, huh?
And you want to improve your skills in a short amount of time.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: —So straightforward and honest.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Sure, you're a bit more decent to watch than when you started,
but you're still no match for me.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: If you wanna beg for a handicap, now's your chance.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
You've gotten quite snappy lately, haven't you?
I don't like it.

The game was nine-ball.
Quietly, the match of a lifetime began. However—
(Clang...)

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: ...Tsk.

Sirius Symboli was completely off her game.
She missed shots she'd normally make,
failing to pocket a single ball cleanly.

The game progressed...
and soon arrived at the turn before Sirius Symboli's.

The 9-ball stopped just before the corner pocket,
and the 8-ball rolled close to it as well.

"If she pockets it with a combination shot,
it's her victory."

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: ...Damn it, you're so loud...!

There was no one around,
with only quiet background music playing.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: ...Not you.

Looking irritated,
Sirius Symboli readied her cue stick.
It was a board state that required technique, but it shouldn't have been difficult for her. And yetâ

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: —Kh!
Her cue ball veered off—a scratch.

The chance has come around to my side.
Focusing, I strike; the cue ball hits the 8-ball, and the 8-ball deflects the 9-ball. The 9-ball sinks cleanly into the pocket, and—
I managed to secure a brilliant victory over her in her off-form state...
The overseas campaign has been postponed.

Still... something is really bothering me.
Could today's match truly be called fair?

"She wasn't focused at all today.
That's why—"
(BAM!)

What came back in response was a fierce kick.
Debris crumbled down
from the wall where the blow landed.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Don't you look down on me.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Would you make them run the Derby twice?
Give them another shot just out of pity?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: —The overseas challenge has been postponed.

She turned on her heel, her back growing more distant.
Though anxiety and impatience flared within me—

What on earth happened to make her lose sight of her dream,
or lose her composure...?

Since I don't know the full story yet,
I can't find the right words to say.
Half-hearted comfort might only end up hurting her pride.
choice_data_list: (Right now, I need to stay calm and focus on what needs to be done...)

text_block_list.text:
Anyway, there were just too many things I didn't understand.
...I decided to reach out to someone who suddenly popped into mind.

text_block_list.name: Sirius's Follower A
text_block_list.text:
Has anything changed with Sirius-san lately?
Hmm, it's pretty hard to tell with her.

text_block_list.name: Sirius's Follower B
text_block_list.text:
Ah, but still! She seemed unusually happy
about taking on the overseas challenge with President Rudolf, didn't she?
choice_data_list: Huh, was that how it was?

text_block_list.name: Sirius's Follower B
text_block_list.text: Hmm, they did say something along those lines.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"Ain't too thrilled about taggin' along,
but checkin' out the venue beforehand ain't bad."

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...Above all, running wild overseas with that guy
is bound to show us some interesting sights.

text_block_list.name: Sirius's Follower B
text_block_list.text:
...or so.
I just thought it was kinda unusual, y'know?

text_block_list.name: Sirius's Follower B
text_block_list.text: Dunno if she realizes it or not, but the vibe was totally hyping up President Rudolf a bit.
Deep down, she had hoped to run wild overseas alongside Symboli Rudolf.

That's why she wouldn't say something like that
unless it was to someone whose skill she truly acknowledged.

In other words...
deep down, you believed that
"Symboli Rudolf's running has true value"—

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Right now—all I can think about is painting over
the glorious achievements that 'guy' made.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
I wouldn't race that punk even if they begged me on their knees.
They're not worth it anymore.
Those words were not what they truly felt after all.

—She avoids 'direct confrontations.'
Her reason being that 'they hold no value.'

“Still, deep down, I don't truly believe
that it has 'no value.'”

"Why did I end up carrying around
such complicated, tangled feelings?"
—Suddenly, I recall the speculation I made before.

When I saw Symboli Rudolf like that—
having changed so much from the figure I had once admired—
Namely, that they may have wished for things to "go back to the way they were."
Namely, whether she had wished for "their relationship to return to how it was"—
If all of those speculations were correct...
Even if deep down they were thinking, "I want things to go back to how they were" or "I want our old relationship back," they kept a lid on those feelings.
What having a "head-to-head showdown" truly means is—
choice_data_list: You'll have to confront those feelings you've kept bottled up.

text_block_list.text: —It was an emotion far too intense to confront.

A sense of loss and loneliness, like falling down a bottomless pitâ
and alongside it, jealousy.

A muddy "emotion" that had no right existing
within his fierce, unyielding self.

That is why I convinced myself that 'fighting has no value,'
using that excuse to avoid it.
――One by one, the tangled strings began to unravel.

Looking back, the fact that she was constantly spitting
venom about Symboli Rudolf's achievements—
choice_data_list: (It's not just because I don't like it...)

text_block_list.text: It was a sort of alert.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Quit starin' at junk.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
5 Gâ  wins so far.
I can see why people are making a fuss calling it a historic feat.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
You've earned yourself quite an impressive credential.
I bet the 'Emperor' couldn't be happier, huh?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Holding off the fierce onslaught with a textbook front-running strategy, she claimed victory by 3/4 of a length.
Becoming the first undefeated Triple Crown champion in Japanese history.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
――
I'll win, and paint over everything...!

Symboli Rudolf's meteoric rise
was something that ate away at her heart.
That is precisely why—

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: I'll trample down... every last bit of it.
Those words were born.
choice_data_list: (...I sort of understand the situation now.)

text_block_list.text:
"If things go on like this, I might eventually
even lose sight of my true dream."

I open the notebook and review what needs to be done.
At the very least, before the upcoming Kikuka Sho, I must—
I have to reclaim that light.
